text: After 25 years, it was time for a home makeover.  I chose Beauty Kiss for my flooring. We chose CoreTec vinyl plank flooring for most of the house and carpet for the bedrooms. I could not be happier.  The techs are great and hardworking.  The lead tech, Adolpho, would let me decide how to proceed where there were options. The company rep, Mike, helped us make good decisions based on years of flooring installations and product awareness. We openly discussed our needs and the durability of all of our flooring choices. The 4 person crew moved along like a well oiled machine. My advice to anyone wanting to replace their flooring is  to choose the correct products with the help of a professional, not a salesperson and prepare for the technicians to have a nice open workspace. My techs were appreciative of their "office" being ready for business. Thanks to all who helped us. Mike, Adolpho, Ian, Poncho and Ulysses.

It was great to work with Mike through the selection process.  He was very friendly and helpful in explaining options to meet our needs and budget.  The installation crew did a superb job.  They obviously are very skilled at their work.   They were courteous and arrived each day when they said they would.  They cleaned up thoroughly at the end of each day.  And we appreciated the communication as the job progressed as well as at end of each day that they let us know the plan for the next day.  We are super happy with the results.
Mike and his team were amazing to work with.  Great selection.  Love our new carpet.  Installers were efficient, courteous, quality installers.  Very happy with Beauty-Kiss.  Thanks Mike and team!
The store is great--items neatly organized make selections easy.  Very customer-service oriented.  Happy with the products!
HORRIBLE.

It's been one year and I'm still trying to get my floor fixed. They show up late, show up without the materials they need, or just try put to a bandaid on the problem.  Now after many visits, they recognized that they placed the wrong underlay beneath the planks. If the job was done right the first time, I wouldn't have this problem. Danny my sales rep was not helpful and seemed very annoyed when I told him I still had problems. Definitely not worth the Costco reference or affiliation.  They had to remove the entire floor because the original padding under the floor was the wrong one. The soft padding allowed for the boards to bend and they ended up breaking. They replaced the soft with shiny firm underlay seen in the upper half of the picture.
beware.. we are now taking them to small claims court .. the laminite  floors in all 4 room stated to buckle within a month..  see photos on yelp..
Great service and great prices. We recommend them to our clients and they have carpeted numerous homes that we have sold.
Very happy with the Services. I got a refill for builder gel and Wendy, the technician did a great job making the nails look very natural.
Alex was so great! Best pedicure I ever had honestly
Both Vee and Emily do my nails and they always do an exceptional job. And everybody in the salon are so sweet and friendly. I’ve been going here for years.
The best!! So happy to have found this salon. Kind, professional, accommodating, and talented technicians! Will always come back to this salon.

Clean place. Subpar customer service. Subpar service. I took my friend bc his feet were in bad shape, but his tech did a great job on him. I asked that my toenails shaping be corrected before my tech started painting my nails bc everyone knows when they are filed afterwards it unseals the nail. It's a trick tech use to insure you return. The shapes of my index toes were still ugly and the paint on my pinky toe of my left foot chipped already or wasn't fully painted in the first place. I shaped my index toes before I left since they were ruined anyway. I usually tip  at least $30 for my feet bc I have small toenails and both of my middle toenails are kind of oddly shaped, but this time I tipped $0. The tech didn't listen, made me feel like I was bothering her, and didn't do a good job on my nails. The pedicure was a gel milk and honey spa pedicure for $85. The place was out of the way for me abd closer to my friend, but we won't be going back. Not worth the money, time, or experience.

I’ve been coming here for some time and I always always will pick Emily! She is freaking amazing she delivers precision, art, and efficiency each time. I will never cheat on her, she gives me the best pedicures everrrrrr and I never have an issue with my nails. Plus she always has the cutest set of nails! Thank you Emily for always setting the standard <3

I’ve been going to Kissme Nail Spa for a while now, and always had a great experience getting my manicures and pedicures done.  💅🏾 Ninie done my nails every time & she is absolutely amazing! She has a real talent for taking a nail inspo photo (or idea) and turning it into reality. I love her attention to detail, while also caring about the health and condition of your natural nails.  The salon is always welcoming and professional and I’ve never felt rushed. I especially love is their loyalty program, where you earn rewards after 10 visits, which is a great bonus 💫!
I stopped in for a manicure and pedicure.  Both were done very well.  Tee did an excellent job and the leg/foot massage was was wonderful.

Always super professional, friendly, and accommodating to any of the various styles and designs that I ask to get for my manis and pedis. My nails have been in great condition since getting them done here--Togi is my fave :)
Emily was the best!
had an appointment, waited 30 minutes they still didn’t take me. had to go to another salon. not reliable time wise at all, would not recommend

First time here and Nina was absolutely amazing! She understood the assignment and left no crumbs! The salon itself is also so cute and everyone is very accommodating and kind. Will definitely be coming back!
Best manicure I’ve ever received!

EMILY NGUYEN is the best 10/10!!! I am so happy that I chose to come and visit Kisimmee Nail Salon!!  Emily is so precise in her attention to detail, not to mention such a personable young lady.  I appreciate her blessed talent and will definitely be looking forward to my next appointment !!!
First time coming here. Got an acrylic fill on a set I got at another salon. Emily was great, quick, precise, & sweet. Super relaxed environment & reasonable prices. :)

I really enjoyed my nails. I got a liquid gel mani with extensions and cat eye, also a skinny french pedi. My appointment was at 12 but I got in a car accident on route there and they attended me once I arrived.  They were also kind enough to charge my phone so I could Uber back home.

Love love love my toes!!! Deep French was definitely the move. If you’re in need please go see me girl Ninie. She really took her time with the French and checked in with me on color and style every step of the way. All the women here are great and I always enjoy my time!!
Super relaxing and staff was very friendly!

Dee Dee was amazing!!! Will be coming back!
Found Dee/KISSME on social media and couldn't wait to book her. She is so talented. She was able to execute the design I wanted flawlessly. I am so happy with my nails. I can't wait to go back!

Absolutely loved my experience here! I got the cutest nails ever, the design turned out even better than I imagined. The staff was incredibly kind and welcoming, and everything was super clean and well-maintained. You can really tell they care about their work and their clients. Overall such a great vibe and experience, I’ll definitely be coming back!
I’ve been coming here for years. The technicians, especially Togi, are all wonderful. The salon is clean and efficient. Really appreciate the online scheduling too.
Looks exactly like what I wanted and the photo i showed them
Perfect eyebrows done by Yomi!!! Such a good experience!

Loved it here! I’m used to paying extra for long hair but even with the extra fee this was definitely the cheapest I’d ever gotten long layers done. It was exactly the way I wanted it too. The whole experience was so relaxing, everyone was super friendly, and appts were easy to make

Yomi & Honey were so such dolls & were so sweet! Yomi did my makeup and I loved it! The environment here was nice & I had a great experience, highly recommend!

Had a hair extension appointment with Minerva. She transformed my hair into something wonderful. I've always hated my thin hair and now I just LOVE the way it looks. She absolutely knows what she's doing. Very professional. Also, everyone there is so very nice and welcoming. Everything about Dose is 5 star! Thanks so much

I’ve damage my hair by box dying it fifty different times. Valarie was able to get my hair from damage and feeling like a bird nest to soft and long hair! Book with Valarie Estrada she’s literally my angel!!

I don't often have much done with my hair and feel awkward at salons, but Lezlie did an awesome job of making me comfortable and did an exceptional job on my hair cut. I will definitely be making any future hair cut appointments with her. Thank you!

She is incredibly sweet, has the best energy, and made the whole experience enjoyable. She worked quickly, but the results were absolutely beautiful! My lashes turned out even better than I expected! It’s obvious she’s talented and truly knows what she’s doing. I’ll definitely be back and can’t wait to book more services with her in the future. Highly recommend!
Ruby washed, cut and styled my hair and she was so sweet!❤️walked me thru everything. Made my natural hair look awesome. Thank you. I’ll be coming back🙏🏽

I took my 10 year old daughter here Saturday for Hair and makeup before her dance competition. We both left so stressed out due to her poor makeup artist. She was late getting us started, had a i don’t care attitude the entire time, had me curl my own daughters lashes, couldn’t put her lashes on, didn’t match her skin tone. Her makeup looked awful. The lady who did her hair did a great job this review isn’t to reflect on her just the makeup artist. Our hair lady had to come back over and put my daughter’s lashes on for us. The makeup artist tried to send us the lashes to put on at the competition venue. Total waste of money for makeup.
Yomi is super sweet she did an amazing job on my eyebrows definitely will be a repeat customer

Had an amazing experience! Highly recommend. Lilliana was so sweet and did a phenomenal job at delivering the look my daughter was wanting for prom! 10/10. Atmosphere was great. Stylist was great. I have no complaints! Ill be booking again for next year!

I’ve got my lash extensions here twice now after trying two other places and they either didn’t last much more than a week or had a weird lash map from both of the other places.  Dose is absolutely amazing! The retention and the design is perfect!  I won’t go anywhere else again.
Fast and friendly service!

Valeria is so talented. I appreciate her artwork and skills and that’s why went with her! We did a makeup trial and I absolutely loved my makeup. She said she would write it all down for the wedding. I paid extra for an hour pre hours appt but she came 10 minutes late. She messaged me that she was running late so I appreciate the communication. The end process was a little confusing because they had increased prices and I had put a deposit and her brother was trying to help but I messaged her after and she squared up the pricing difference. I still paid for the early hour even though she was late.  For the wedding I asked her about some lip colors beforehand and she said she would bring extras I could buy so I can use it during the wedding day. I paid the travel fee and she forgot her ring light and ended up using the one we had at our house. My maid of honor said she was late and flustered. And took a bit to get everything set up. She did my maid of honor’s makeup, then bride’s (mine) then my mom’s. I had put a deposit for mine before the price increase but wasn’t aware of the increase before putting down the other two. That was my own fault for not putting deposit down earlier. My makeup was good but I was disappointed when she told me my lip wasn’t something we could buy (not sure if she brought them with her) even though I messaged her about it beforehand. She helped me find a lip close to what I wanted that I could use day of out of my collection, but it wasn’t exactly what I wanted so I was a disappointed looking at pictures back on it. If I would have known I would have went and bought something. While she was doing my mom’s makeup I was still looking at my makeup deciding if I liked it or not, I was going to have her touch it up when she was done with my mom’s. Next thing I knew she was already gone without asking maid of honor or me if everything was okay. I liked my makeup from the makeup trial more than my wedding makeup. I should have been more vocal, but I didn’t get time or opportunity that morning as bride. She is so talented and I love her work. For the money we paid I just wish those little time management details and checking in with me would have put it over the top especially for such an important day.

Booked with Valeria for a lash lift/tint. She was absolutely amazing at her job, did it very fast and the results are FABULOUS!! Aside from her being very skilled at her job she was very sweet and accommodating, my eyes tend to water (a lot) and not one time did she make me feel nervous or bad about it, she found a solution and got the job done. 10/10 will be booking again!!

Ive booked with Yomi multiple times now for a face wax and i love the results! Has definitely made my skin feel and look so much better. She so kind and makes you feel comfortable. Love the atmosphere of the place and the music taste is chefs kiss. Highly recommend!!!

Using a different Gmail so my name isn’t shown but take this as constructive criticism try to be there more for your loyal clients.
